package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

func TestBlueprintClassificationRequiresPracticeOwnedSurfaceEnum(t *testing.T) {
	for _, invalid := range []string{"", "exercise", "project_task"} {
		classification := Classification{
			TaskType: "BUILD", SurfaceClassification: invalid,
			Domains: []string{"backend"}, Stacks: []string{"go"}, Topology: "backend",
		}
		if err := normalizeBlueprintClassification(&classification); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("surface %q was not rejected: %v", invalid, err)
		}
	}
	classification := Classification{
		TaskType: "BUILD", SurfaceClassification: " PROJECT ",
		Domains: []string{"backend"}, Stacks: []string{"go"}, Topology: "backend",
	}
	if err := normalizeBlueprintClassification(&classification); err != nil || classification.SurfaceClassification != SurfaceClassificationProject {
		t.Fatalf("trusted surface normalization failed: classification=%+v err=%v", classification, err)
	}
}
